LA.Name: Name
LA.NoLevelClass: Add a class to this character before advancing a level.
LA.SelectLevelClassHint: Choose which class the character gains this level in.
LA.AttributeIncreaseHint: This level grants two increases. Choose an attribute for each increase; you may choose the same attribute twice.
LA.SelectTechnickHint: Only Technicks whose prerequisites your character meets are listed. Check one option.
LA.SelectClassBonusTechnickHint: Choose a Technick on this class's bonus list whose prerequisites your character meets.
LA.ChooseOneTechnick: Check exactly one Technick to continue.
LA.NoEligibleTechnicks: No available Technick meets the prerequisites for this advancement.
LA.NoTechnickChoices: No valid options remain for this Technick choice.
LA.EnterLanguagesHint: Enter exactly {count} language(s), separated by commas.
LA.EnterLanguagesError: Enter exactly {count} language(s) to complete this choice.
LA.EmptyHands: Holding no items (enables Brawler Defence bonus)
LA.AdditionalSpellSlots: Additional spell slots from Arcane Study
LA.AdditionalPerformanceSlots: Additional performance slots from Bardic Study
LA.PerformanceRollHint: Roll Perform; the highest reached DC tier determines its effect.
LA.PerformanceFailed: Check below the first effect threshold
LA.PerformanceNoEffect: The Perform check did not reach this performance's first effect threshold.
LA.PerformanceImmunityHint: Immune to this performance until the performer's next turn.
LA.PerformanceAttacksSkillsMinusTwo: -2 to attack rolls and skill checks
LA.UsePerformAsWill: May use the performer's check in place of Will Defence
LA.UsePerformAsFort: May use the performer's check in place of Fortitude Defence
LA.SelectPerformancesHint: Choose exactly {count} new performances. Your selection cannot exceed your available Bardic Study slots.
LA.NotEnoughUnlearnedPerformances: You need {required} performances, but only {available} unlearned choices remain.
LA.NoPerformanceSlots: You need Bardic Study and an open performance slot before learning a performance.
LA.PerformanceAlreadyKnown: This character already knows that performance.
LA.SelectPerformanceTargets: Select the tokens affected before using this performance.
LA.SelectPerformanceAllies: Select allied tokens for this performance.
LA.SelectPerformanceEnemies: Select enemy tokens for this performance.
LA.PerformThreatenedHint: You are threatened by {count} adjacent enemy. Choose a style and whether to perform defensively.
LA.PerformCounterattackHint: This performance may provoke {count} counterattack(s); if one beats the performer's Break Threshold, it fails.
LA.ClassProgressionHint: Enter the class bonuses from the book. Class levels, defence bonuses, and skill bonuses add automatically. Maximum HP and MP stay editable on the character sheet.
LA.AssignAttributesHint: Three 2d6 rolls generate six values. Assign one value to each attribute; each generated value can be used only once.
LA.AssignAttributesUnique: Choose a different generated value for each attribute.
LA.InvalidSpellAutomationJSON: Spell automation must be valid JSON.
LA.SpellFailed: Check below the spell's first threshold
LA.SpellNoEffect: The Spellcraft check did not reach this spell's first effect threshold.
LA.SpellNoEffectApplied: The check succeeded, but no listed effect was applied to the selected target(s).
LA.DamageRolledUnapplied: damage rolled (not applied; no target selected)
LA.ItemRollFailed: The item could not be rolled. See the browser console for details.
LA.SpellNoTargetApplication: no target selected; target-dependent effects are not applied
LA.SpellManualAdjudication: Read the special rules and resolve any positional or table-dependent effects with the GM.
LA.NotEnoughMP: Not enough MP. This spell costs {cost} MP.
LA.SelectSpellTargets: Select the token or tokens affected before casting this magick.
LA.SpellcastingThreatenedHint: Casting defensively avoids provoking a counterattack, but applies -5 to Spellcraft per threatening enemy. Casting normally may provoke counterattacks.
LA.SpellMeleeCounterattackHint: This cast was not defensive. Resolve any counterattacks; if one beats the caster's Break Threshold, the magick fails and its MP remains spent.
LA.SelectTrainedSkillsHint: Choose exactly {count} skills to train. Check the options and confirm the count before continuing.
LA.SelectTrainedSkillsError: Class not applied: exactly {required} skills were required, but {selected} were selected. Drag the class again and try once more.
LA.NotEnoughClassSkills: Class not applied: it requires {required} trained skills, but only {available} are configured for this class. Correct the class skill list in the compendium.
LA.SelectTalentTreeHint: For {className}, choose a tree for this talent. You may choose a tree again at later levels that grant a talent.
LA.TalentPrerequisiteHint: Check the book for exact prerequisites and rules. The chosen talent will be added to the Features tab.
LA.TalentPackUnavailable: The talent compendium is unavailable. Reinstall or update the system and try again.
LA.NoTalentsForTree: No talent entries are registered for the {tree} tree. Update the talent compendium.
